dct_title_s: Soudan Mine, No. 8 Shaft, 17th Level (Map One), Soudan, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A map of the 17th level at the Soudan Mine starting from the No. 8 Shaft going east and weSaint The map shows the drifts, cross cuts, rock formations, raises, core sample drill holes, and stope areas. Lake Superior Datum.
